identificationModule.briefTitle: Exploratory Study of Super DC Cell Injection in Preventing Recurrence After Radical Surgery for Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: Exploratory Study of Super DC Cell Injection in Preventing Recurrence After Radical Surgery for Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is a controlled, open-label exploratory clinical trial.

armGroups.label: Group 1
armGroups.description: A single dose of 1×10\^7 cells, with a dosing interval of 1 week or 2 weeks during the induction period.

armGroups.label: Group 2
armGroups.description: A single dose of 2×10\^7 cells, with a dosing interval of 1 week or 2 weeks during the induction period.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Within 28 days after the first injection
